interpretation: All four exact products pass original-hit pregates and strict source16/downstream64 audits, but each has complete valid top-three model predictions with no exact full-product match. Alkyl bromide request predicts multiple substitutions or altered sulfur connectivity; secondary alcohol request predicts multiple substitutions, with Na+ in two beams. These are observed prediction differences, not independently validated chemistry or physical synthesis failure. Do not remove ions/stereochemistry, pick only a regioisomer, or count a model-mismatched route as supported.
decision: Do not claim the explicit fallback second-reactant change improves supported route coverage. Preserve its pre-evidence-only result and keep current implementation experimental. Do not repeat full panel on this evidence alone.
